lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: We must needs borrow the strength of the Ark.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We will do no such thing.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'd really rather not.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Hmmm... I did reckon this matter would not be met with welcome, yet ne'er did I foresee so chill a reception.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pray, attend closely.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: How it came to pass I cannot rightly discern, but from the Queen's body did Liliweiss appear.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... By her state and demeanor, 'tis plain she is not the true Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The most reasonable supposition is that the Queen hath... by some means, seized the body of Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: In sooth, the Queen yet abideth.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Meanwhile, grievous losses have we suffered,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and the strength we once possessed returneth not.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Moreover, the Queen is a foe the Ark must needs vanquish;

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: there lieth no cause for us to forbear alliance with them.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I refuse.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: If we strike after thorough preparation, victory is certain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: What manner of preparation dost thou speak?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: In the present plight, naught remaineth for us but to clasp hands with the Ark, else victory is beyond our reach. This, verily, is certain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... So it is. Whether ye oppose or consent, 'tis of little concern to me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: All that behoveth is that I hie me unto the Ark and entreat their succour.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Do as you please.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Consider yourself fortunate if you're not scrapped.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pride hath no place at this hour. Use what means thou must...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I said we have no need of them, Monk.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I agree.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Cast thine eyes out the window, Young Hero Johan.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: What dost thou see?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: The surface.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pray, how doth thou find it?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Is it delightful to behold nature at peace and in resplendent blossom?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Get to the point.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I abhor it.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The sight thereof doth fill me with loathing.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I delight in great buildings rising skyward, carriages coursing hither and thither, and the throngs of mankind in lively commotion.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This desolate world, I tell thee, is a spectacle most vile.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pray, what deemest thou hath rendered this place so forlorn?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis on account of them.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Raptures and their Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: By their hand is the world thus brought low.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Hast thou grown accustomed thereto?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: After decades upon this barren surface, hath this wretched scene become familiar unto thee?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: As for me, I shall ne'er grow fond of it!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Though thousands of mine replicas have gazed upon this land a countless number of times, still do I hold it in abhorrence!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: No spot doth invite my gaze; all appeareth loathsome unto mine eyes!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Dost thou spurn the aid of the Ark? Out of pride? Or because thou canst not forgive their trespasses?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Awaken thyselves! Now is no hour for trifling with petty matters!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen hath descended, and she hath seized the body of the strongest Nikke, Liliweiss!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Seest thou any prospect of triumph? E'en the slightest chance thereof?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Nay! Thou seest it not!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And yet thou persistest in prating of reclaiming the surface by thine own strength. What hubris...!

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Hast thy wits been undone by too long a sojourn upon this forsaken land?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Prithee... behold the truth.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: How can folk of thy stature be thus...

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: There is a way.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Pray... a way to what?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: A method to wield the Ark's power without borrowing it.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The Ark is currently preparing for the Third Surface Reclamation War.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: They're enamored with their new technology and have been quietly amassing power in secret.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: New technology...?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Yes, Eden's technology.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: ... So that's why you've been smuggling out data.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm fanning the flames.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: If the Queen is their goal, that makes stoking the fire even easier.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: When the time comes, we'll use that to our advantage.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: The Ark will pour everything they have into the surface.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: And whatever they gain from wasting their strength,

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: we can take it from them.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: That is far worse.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: That is utterly despicable.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Cease thy lamentations. Rather than disparaging each notion, I entreat thee to henceforth proffer thine own counsel.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To charge into a conflict bereft of all hope of triumph doth not, verily, constitute a sound stratagem.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: We will borrow his power.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Dost thou speak of the Great Hero?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: So it is. I make no objection thereto.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet—

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: If he refuses to cooperate, or cooperation is impossible,

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: or even with his help, there's no chance of victory...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Then we turn to the Ark for aid.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... I hate it too.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: This hollow world.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Understood. My thanks to thee.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Make preparations.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I'll be the one to contact him.
Johan turns around and walks away.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Johan.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Harran, Isabel, and Noah...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Dorothy,

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: you are hereby expelled from both Inherit and Eden.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You are not to return.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Why are you so surprised? If you didn't see this coming,

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: you're dumber than I thought.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Leave.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: As you said, only the chosen may set foot in paradise.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Are they all... going to make it?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Marian, Scarlet, and Rapunzel shall manage somehow, it seemeth.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: But... that child Noah...

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ah, nay. Perchance I heard amiss.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: 'Tis said all goes smoothly, yea. 'Tis said they shall live.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Okay, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Papillon, was it?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Yes, Crown.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: May I offer you a cup of tea?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Tea, is it?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Sure. No point just sitting here twiddling our thumbs. It won't change a thing.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Come on, let's have some tea and a little chat.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: That would be lovely.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Kilo, please prepare the picnic set.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: T.A.L.O.S., could you prepare Picnic Set F?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Roger, setting up now.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: You go around carrying stuff like this?

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: Yes, you never know what might happen.

lines.speaker: kilo
lines.text: And there's really nothing better than this to calm your nerves.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Right.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: So the mind is the problem.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: So in the end...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: ... Yes, Snow White?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Come back.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: We have a common goal: the Queen.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: So stop that disgraceful work, and fight alongside me.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Disgraceful... work?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Do you also think what I'm doing is disgraceful?

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm doing this for all of you...!

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: No, you're doing it for yourself.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: We have forgiven them.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Now it's your turn to forgive.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Go ahead and forgive them as much as you like.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I, however, shan't.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: The Queen...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: is defiling one of our own.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: What... did you just say?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I'll never forgive her for this.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Lilith should be sleeping peacefully in her resting place,

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: but that monster stole her.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: You... remember...!?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: So, Dorothy,

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: come and fight with me.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: Let's kill the guy

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: who so casually snapped off Lilith,

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: the most beautiful flower in the world.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: There isn't much time left.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Really, not much. So...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: have changed a lot.
Dorothy flies away, disappearing into the air.
Snow White lingers, staring blankly at her retreating figure
for a long moment.
A sad realization dawns on her:
those days are gone, never to return.
The once-brilliant past has now completely faded.
GODDESS FALL: END

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Something extraordinary has occurred.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, 'tis even so.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: So this is why you were so desperate to get to Liliweiss's body.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I never expected the Vapaus to only destroy the Queen's main body. Considering how concentrated it must have been,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: it must be because her physical body was truly, in every sense, a monster.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... *Sigh* Who would've thought the lie I told Chatterbox would actually come true... I really didn't see this coming.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, this may give rise unto other unforeseen events as well.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I do hope so.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: What about Scarlet?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She doth not fare exceedingly well.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis said she must needs be remade from the very foundations.

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: From scratch? What happens then?

lines.speaker: janghwa_n
lines.text: Will her memories be intact? Will—
Rose's body goes limp, like a puppet with severed strings.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Really now... Why interrupt an important discussion?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: This is precisely why having too strong a sense of self can be a problem.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What about Marian?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: It doth appear that she may indeed be sustained by the affixing of a pseudo-core.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet, since 'tis not her proper core, its vigour shall not be infinite, nor her output without bounds.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Verily, 'tis more a measure to clutch at the thread of her life than aught else.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Thank goodness, her brain remains intact. Some Queen Gene may yet remain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, the Queen hath absorbed Young Lady Marian's Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Her dominion as a Queen is now beyond all compare.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Queen Gene isn't entirely gone, is it? Then something can still be done.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Of course, that "something" is a problem for you to solve.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: But really, how do you plan on dealing with this?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Queen, who now has the body of the strongest Nikke, Liliweiss...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How do you intend to defeat her?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... This I do ponder.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You really should think things through—

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: carefully, patiently, until you're absolutely sure.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: As for me... heh,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I can return to the Queen anytime...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: as if nothing happened.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If I see that Marian has no chance, then I suppose I must.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: If that be so, would it not be wise to dissolve the alliance forthwith?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Verily, I discern that no further advantage may be had from thee henceforth.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh my, I suppose you're right.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I have a proposition, verily.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: All right. Given the circumstances, that does seem like our best chance.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis fortunate thou art quick of perception.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I'll stay close to the Queen

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: and send you the latest intel as it comes in, so be sure to make good use of it.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh, right. You don't have any clones left, right? You obliterated them all.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Then how am I supposed to deliver this top-grade intel to you?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You still have some left, don't you?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: So it is.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Ever shall I remain beside thee, so let thy mind be untroubled.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Haha, just how many of these did you make?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: All right then, time to get moving.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Let's give it everything we've got

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: for our Queen.
